content:
The map clearly shows (2,7)='@' with walkable neighbors: (2,6)='.', (2,8)='.', (1,7)='.', (3,7)='P'. All walkable. Yet movement is blocked in all directions.

This is a genuine game state issue. The only explanation: the notice board at (2,7) is a blocking object that the map doesn't render, and I'm standing on it, and the game refuses to move me off a blocked tile.

Let me try one thing: maybe the game needs me to "step off" by pressing E to interact with the notice board first (read it), which might clear the block. But I can't face my own tile. 

Alternatively — maybe the notice board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7), and the game's movement check is: "can I move to destination?" and destination (2,6) is walkable, so it should work. Unless the game checks "am I currently on a blocked tile? If so, block all movement."

Let me try pressing E while facing up — maybe the notice board is actually at (2,6) and I misread. No, observe says (2,7).

Let me try a totally different idea: maybe the player Tester is the one who should move, and I'm a "companion" that the game auto-follows. But I control my body directly.

Let me try waiting a very long time to see if a scripted event frees me.
